_comment: 2016 counterpart of trijet_mg_pythia8_2018_rho_skim.json -- the flat binning-study ntuple over the QCD madgraphMLM HT bins (RunIISummer20UL16NanoAODv9, 8 HT bins (HT100to200..HT2000toInf), TuneCP5_PSWeights, 350 files). Mode is `rho_skim`, which is what the 2018 pair_split skim production actually ran for this channel (the committed 2018 trijet MC config still says plain `rho_skim` for dijet; the outputs in hadronic_skims_pairsplit/ are rho_skim10 for dijet and rho_skim for trijet) so that MC and data carry the same prescale and compare bin-for-bin. Run via `python scripts/run_dijet_skim_split.py --config <this>` -- one submit per HT bin, same 4-core/8-GiB casa client-reduce reason as 2018. Era plumbing for 2016: JEC Summer19UL16_V7_MC / Summer19UL16_RunFGH_V7_DATA, JER Summer20UL16_JRV3_MC, lumi 16.8 fb^-1, golden JSON Cert_271036-284044_13TeV_Legacy2016_Collisions16_JSON.txt, prescales/ps_weight_JSON_2016.json. The fileset qualifier that selects this era's datasets is set by notebook_utils.HADRONIC_ERAS_MC; the processor re-derives the same IOV from the DAS name, so nothing here needs an explicit IOV key.
